panels.title: Trading post — cumulative bought vs sold vs net (gold)

targets.rawSql: WITH cum AS (SELECT purchased_at, sum(CASE WHEN kind='buy' THEN price*quantity ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY purchased_at) AS bought_c, sum(CASE WHEN kind='sell' THEN price*quantity ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY purchased_at) AS sold_c, sum(CASE WHEN kind='sell' THEN price*quantity ELSE -price*quantity END) OVER (ORDER BY purchased_at) AS net_c FROM tp_transactions), anchor AS (SELECT b.recorded_at, b.coin, COALESCE((SELECT c.net_c FROM cum c WHERE c.purchased_at <= b.recorded_at ORDER BY c.purchased_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0) AS net_at FROM account_balance b ORDER BY b.recorded_at LIMIT 1), tx AS (SELECT c.purchased_at AS time, c.bought_c, c.sold_c, c.net_c, CASE WHEN c.purchased_at < a.recorded_at THEN a.coin - (a.net_at - c.net_c) END AS balance_c FROM cum c LEFT JOIN anchor a ON true), carry AS (SELECT now() AS time, bought_c, sold_c, net_c, NULL::numeric AS balance_c FROM cum ORDER BY purchased_at DESC LIMIT 1), snap AS (SELECT recorded_at AS time, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, coin::numeric FROM account_balance) SELECT time, bought_c/10000.0 AS bought, sold_c/10000.0 AS sold, net_c/10000.0 AS net, balance_c/10000.0 AS balance FROM (SELECT * FROM tx UNION ALL SELECT * FROM carry UNION ALL SELECT * FROM snap) x ORDER BY time;
SELECT fmt_coin(max(net_profit)) AS value FROM craft_roi;
SELECT (extract(epoch FROM max(updated_at)) * 1000)::bigint AS value FROM craft_roi;

panels.title: Top craftable items by net profit (craft-and-list)

targets.rawSql: SELECT output_item_name AS item, fmt_coin(net_profit) || ' (' || CASE WHEN out_of_pocket > 0 THEN round(net_roi_pct::numeric, 1)::text || '%' ELSE 'free' END || ')' AS profit, sell_sold_day || '/d in ' || round(days_to_sell::numeric, 2) || 'd' AS demand, output_item_id AS item_id FROM craft_roi ORDER BY craft_roi.net_profit DESC;

panels.title: Recipes to buy (unlearned sheets), by net profit

targets.rawSql: SELECT output_item_name AS item, fmt_coin(net_profit) || ' (' || CASE WHEN out_of_pocket > 0 THEN round(net_roi_pct::numeric, 1)::text || '%' ELSE 'free' END || ')' AS profit, sell_sold_day || '/d in ' || round(days_to_sell::numeric, 2) || 'd' AS demand, 'https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Recipe:%20' || replace(replace(output_item_name, '''', '%27'), ' ', '%20') AS link FROM craft_roi_learnable ORDER BY craft_roi_learnable.net_profit DESC;
